explanation: The statement is that the operator modulus |T| = CFC.sqrt (T† ∘L T) is unchanged under T ↦ -T. The modulus is defined in this library (ContinuousLinearMap.modulus). Mathlib has no operator modulus or absolute value for continuous linear maps: grepping Mathlib/Analysis/InnerProductSpace for "modulus" only finds TwoDim.lean, which is unrelated. So there is no Mathlib declaration that states this result. The content is the identity (-T)† ∘L (-T) = T† ∘L T, which follows from the definition.
